faqs.question: Do I need a doctor's prescription for hormone therapy?
faqs.answer: Yes. All hormone optimization treatments are prescription medications. You will consult with our licensed medical doctor who reviews your health history and bloodwork before prescribing a custom plan tailored to your body.

faqs.question: What does the doctor-guided hormone program include?
faqs.answer: Your program includes direct consultations with our board-certified medical doctor, full baseline and follow-up blood tests, custom pharmacy-grade bio-identical hormones, and ongoing medical check-ins to make sure you stay safe and feel your best.

faqs.question: How fast will I feel results from hormone therapy?
faqs.answer: Most patients report higher daily energy, better sleep, and improved mood within 2 to 4 weeks. Major benefits like fat loss, lean muscle gains, sharp focus, and restored drive build steadily over 6 to 12 weeks.

faqs.question: Is hormone therapy safe for both men and women?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our treatments use natural bio-identical hormones tailored specifically for men and women. Because our licensed doctors measure your exact blood levels, your protocol is always safe, balanced, and targeted to your body.

faqs.question: Will I get bad side effects or dangerous steroid effects?
faqs.answer: No. Steroids use dangerous, unmonitored doses. We prescribe natural bio-identical hormones calibrated strictly to your body's healthy young range. Regular doctor check-ins and lab checks keep your treatment safe and side-effect free.

faqs.question: How do I get started with hormone optimization?
faqs.answer: Getting started is simple! Call our clinic today at (727) 476-8966 or click 'Book Your Doctor Consultation' online. Our doctor will order a quick blood test, review your results, and launch your personalized vitality plan.
